expo.name: SoulMatch
expo.description: Match based on who you actually are. SoulMatch uses a deep psychology assessment — attachment style, values, communication patterns — to find your most compatible romantic partners and closest friendships.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SoulMatch uses your camera to let you add a profile photo so matches can see who you are.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SoulMatch accesses your photo library so you can choose a profile photo from your existing photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: SoulMatch saves profile photos to your photo library when you request it.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SoulMatch uses your location to show you compatible people nearby. Location is never shared with other users without your permission.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationUsageDescription: SoulMatch sends you notifications when you have a new match or message.

plugins.photosPermission: SoulMatch accesses your photos to let you set a profile picture.
plugins.cameraPermission: SoulMatch uses your camera to take a profile photo.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: SoulMatch uses your location to show you compatible people nearby.
